No sessionStores-related type errors. Everything's in order.

## Summary

Files changed:
- `src/packages/agent/sessionStores.ts` — `createInteractiveSessionStore`/`createHeadlessSessionStore` no longer `require('@thyrox/repl/onChangeAppState.js')`; they take an optional `onChange` parameter (no-op default) so the caller supplies the listener instead. Docstring updated to record the measured cause (the require specifier stayed in `Bun.build`'s static graph — ~151 `repl` modules — even though it was already execution-lazy) and the divergence (no current caller wires the real `onChangeAppState`).
- `src/packages/agent/__tests__/sessionStoresImports.test.ts` (new) — asserts no direct edge of `sessionStores.ts` in the `Bun.build` metafile points into `packages/repl`, plus a runtime `require.cache` check; verified red-before/green-after via a stash-based anulación check.

Measured and out of scope: `appStateCompatShim.ts` (in `app-host`, not `sessionStores.ts`) independently drags ~150 `repl` modules via `state/AppStateCompat.ts → repl/promptSuggestion.js` — a separate, pre-existing coupling untouched by this cut and outside my file scope.
